facts.title: Peach Crisp (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 2 ¼ pounds ripe peaches, peeled and thinly sliced (about 5 to 6 medium-to-large)
1 cup old-fashioned oats (certified gluten free if necessary)
½ cup almond meal or almond flour, lightly packed
⅓ cup packed coconut sugar or brown sugar
¼ teaspoon fine grain sea salt
3 to 4 tablespoons plain yogurt (regular or Greek)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
